Scouting Summary

Common themes

  • Right Fast, averaging 132.7 kph (up to 139.2).
  • Typical length is 7-8m (their good length); median 7.6 m.
  • Stock ball is a good length outside off, passing outside off (19% of deliveries).
  • Goes round the wicket 7% of the time against right-handers.
  • Across an over he varies his length a lot.

Biggest threats

  • Most dangerous length is Back of Length (3 wkts, 3.6% adjusted strike).
  • Danger pitching line: Stumps.
  • Takes 17% of wickets pitching a good length on the 6th stump.
  • Beats the bat 0.6% of tracked balls (false-shot 18.2%).
  • Gets you caught behind more than most — 88% of his wickets (1.3× the typical rate for this type).
  • 0% of catches are behind the wicket (keeper / slips / gully).

Areas to exploit

  • Concedes most runs pitching full in the 4th-stump channel (12% of runs).
  • Short ball: 27% of deliveries, economy 2.9 — 5 wkts from 101 short balls.
  • Away from back of length, the wicket threat drops off — look to score in the less-productive lengths.
  • Most of his runs leak straight down the ground (80%) — his main scoring release.
  • Cash in when he goes full outside off (economy 6.3, beats the bat only 25%).
